description: Overview of UDP and TCP traffic plus exporter health. The dashboard is split into collapsible sections so summary and detailed traffic panels can be hidden independently.

panels.description: Number of active UDP operator sessions for the selected filters when session labels are present; falls back to raw stream count outside operator-managed environments.

targets.expr: ((count(count by (session_id) (iperf_exporter_udp_bandwidth{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode", connection_pair=~"$connection_pair", session_id!=""})) ) or vector(0)) + (((count(count by (connection_pair, peer_port, peer_id) (iperf_exporter_udp_bandwidth{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode", connection_pair=~"$connection_pair", session_id=""})) )) or vector(0))

panels.title: TCP Reads

panels.description: Seconds since the newest valid UDP interval report in the selected topology. This is traffic freshness, not scrape freshness.

targets.expr: (time() - max(iperf_exporter_sample_timestamp_seconds{proto="udp",measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Latest UDP Sample Age

panels.description: Seconds since the newest valid TCP interval report in the selected topology. This is traffic freshness, not scrape freshness.

targets.expr: (time() - max(iperf_exporter_sample_timestamp_seconds{proto="tcp",measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Latest TCP Sample Age

panels.description: Exporter-observed error and timeout outcomes during the last hour. Success is intentionally excluded.

targets.expr: sum(increase(iperf_exporter_test_runs_total{result=~"error|timeout",measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Test Failures (1h)

panels.description: Parse failures plus socket/path-trace collector failures during the last hour.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(iperf_exporter_parse_errors_total{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(iperf_exporter_collector_errors_total{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[1h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Exporter Errors (1h)

panels.description: Observed iperf test outcomes by protocol. Success is the first valid interval for a connection; timeout is TTL eviction before a valid interval; error is an iperf child restart.

targets.expr: sum by (proto, result) (increase(iperf_exporter_test_runs_total{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Test Outcomes

panels.description: Parser, collector and background path-trace failures over Grafana's rate interval.

targets.expr: sum by (proto) (increase(iperf_exporter_parse_errors_total{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (collector, reason) (increase(iperf_exporter_collector_errors_total{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (proto, reason) (increase(iperf_exporter_path_trace_failures_total{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Exporter Error Events

panels.description: Prometheus scrape health for the iperf operator metrics endpoint.

targets.expr: max(up{job="iperf-operator"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Operator Up

panels.description: Failed operator reconciliations during the last hour across all custom-resource kinds.

targets.expr: sum(increase(iperf_operator_reconciliations_total{result="error"}[1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reconcile Errors (1h)

panels.description: MeasurementSession finalizers currently waiting for workload cleanup.

targets.expr: max(iperf_operator_finalizers_pending) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pending Finalizers

panels.description: RemoteCluster resources whose latest connectivity check failed.

targets.expr: count(iperf_operator_remote_cluster_up == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Remote Clusters Down

panels.description: Completed one-shot probe Jobs grouped by result and deduplicated by Kubernetes Job UID.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (increase(iperf_operator_probe_runs_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Probe Job Outcomes

panels.description: 95th percentile reconciliation duration by custom-resource kind.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (rate(iperf_operator_reconciliation_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))
